DIV5.HEAD: PART 260—AIRLINE REFUNDS AND OTHER CONSUMER PROTECTIONS

DIV8.HEAD: § 260.1 Purpose.
DIV8.P: This part requires prompt refunds when an airline cancels or significantly changes a flight and the consumer does not accept an alternative.

DIV8.HEAD: § 260.6 Refunds for airline-caused changes.
DIV8.P: (a) A carrier must provide a prompt automatic refund when:
(1) The carrier cancels or makes a significant change to a flight;
(2) The passenger does not accept alternative transportation, travel credit, voucher, or other compensation; and
(3) The passenger is entitled to a refund under this part.
(b) Refunds must be provided in the original form of payment.
